# custom_object_tool

> Define custom object TYPES (e.g.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=custom_object_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Define custom object TYPES (e.g. "Engine", "Pump") with typed fields, and read/write
records of those types. Use this instead of general_crud_tool whenever the data is a
user-defined object rather than a built-in model.

ACTIONS:
- list_types: every custom object type in the tenant, with its field count.
- describe_type: one type's full field schema — key, type, label, required, options.
  ALWAYS call this before create_record so you write the keys the type actually defines.
- define_type: create a type, or replace its fields. `fields` is an array of
  {key, label, type, required?, options?, help_text?, display_order?}.
  Supported types: text, textarea, number, date, datetime, boolean, select,
  multi_select, url, email, phone, color, json. select/multi_select REQUIRE options;
  pass them as a plain string list (["petrol","diesel"]) or as {value,label} objects.
- create_record / update_record: a record of a type, with `values` keyed by field key.
- list_records: records of one type, newest first.

STRICT BY DEFAULT: a value whose key the type does not define is REJECTED, and the
error names the valid keys. This is deliberate — it stops a typo'd key from being
silently stored where nothing will ever read it. Pass strict_fields: false on
define_type only when you genuinely want a freeform bag.

EXAMPLES:
{action: "define_type", identifier: "engine", label: "Engine", fields: [
  {key: "torque_nm", label: "Torque (Nm)", type: "number", required: true},
  {key: "rpm", label: "Max RPM", type: "number"},
  {key: "fuel", label: "Fuel", type: "select", options: ["petrol", "diesel"]}]}
{action: "describe_type", identifier: "engine"}
{action: "create_record", identifier: "engine", description: "M20B25",
 values: {torque_nm: 222, rpm: 6500, fuel: "petrol"}}
{action: "list_records", identifier: "engine"}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | One of: list_types, describe_type, define_type, create_record, update_record, list_records. |
| `identifier` | string | no | The type identifier, e.g. "engine". Required for everything but list_types. |
| `label` | string | no | define_type: human label for the type. |
| `fields` | array of object | no | define_type: the field schema. Replaces the type's existing fields. |
| `strict_fields` | boolean | no | define_type: reject undefined keys on records of this type (default true) |
| `record_id` | integer | no | update_record: the record to change. |
| `description` | string | no | create_record/update_record: the record label. |
| `values` | object | no | create_record/update_record: values keyed by field key. |
| `limit` | integer | no | list_records: max rows (default 25) |
